description: Estimates of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Bureau of Statistics. This data contains Census-based estimates of the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander population and non-Indigenous Australians for various geographies. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as less than annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
